moment: the live surfaces — a `/con` becomes a card, a press is refused and then taken, and the modules say they moved
source: JOS-487 (cutover ledger items 3, 4 and 6; boundary verdicts 2 and 6)
note: THREE THINGS THE ENGINE SAYS WITHOUT BEING ASKED, and one command it can refuse. The `conCard` frame is boundary verdict 2 landing: the fold used to call synchronously INTO Electron through `considerModule.setConCardHook`, and the verdict inverts it — the engine resolves the whole card and main only opens the window. Like a fire it carries NO `id` and NO `epoch`: a con belongs to the world rather than to any subscription, and it is a thing that happened once, with no window state to reconcile across a generation. LOOK AT THE CHIPS. All five axes are present in `RESIST_AXES` order, every count is a real zero, and `spellData` is FALSE — which is not a stub but the branch `mobResistProfile` itself takes app-side when the client's `spells_us.txt` has not been read. That parse is boundary verdict 7 and has not moved engine-side, so the con-card CUTOVER waits on it while this frame does not: the shape is final and the chips fill in with no protocol change. THE TWO MARKS ARE THE SAME PRESS TWICE. Mid-fold the world is `folding` and the answer is `accepted: false` — which is NOT an error, it is `combat/engine.ts sessionMark`'s `if (st.hydrating) return false` in the protocol's own words, and it is what makes replay determinism structural: a mark is stored nowhere and cannot enter a replaying fold. The ack carries the STATUS it decided under so a client is not left racing a fold that went live between the refusal and a follow-up question. Once live the same press is taken, and the engine keeps nothing — an accepted mark changes no state this protocol can show you, which is why the ack does not pretend to report one. THE `moduleChanged` FRAMES are the dirty bit: a name and a cursor and no state at all, one per changed module per serve beat (~10 Hz), so a client holding a `module.snapshot` compares the two numbers and refetches only when this one is ahead. A frame that carried the state would be `module.snapshot` pushed at a cadence nobody asked for, which is the per-window snapshot fan-out this whole boundary exists to delete.
